title: First bounded consumption wave for the largelexicon typed bridge candidates

scope.summary: The A3 bridge emits candidate-or-unresolved typed-claim records from carried target-schema rows, loc-first, abstaining on collisions, page-context-only rows, root-only relations, normalized-only matches and unaccepted crosswalk addresses. This packet consumes one bounded wave of its CANDIDATE records: it checks each candidate against the sarf evidence ladder and routes it to two-vote, source-gap or rejected. It never certifies from the bridge output itself.
out_of_scope: certifying a lexeme, form, sense or root edge from a bridge candidate: the bridge projector is registered never_auto_resolve and has no certification path
resolving a lexical_collision_requires_context record by picking a candidate
consuming any abstained record as if it were a candidate
any live-surface mutation, entry-store write, or public materialization

commands.purpose: produce the bounded wave of typed-claim records for review
re-prove the bridge behaviour before consuming anything it emitted
re-prove the committed fixtures and the real-data scan are fresh

candidate_population.selection_rule: the CANDIDATE-status records of the first 2,000 carried crosswalk rows in manifest order, as counted in qamus/examples/largelexicon-fact-bridge/real-data-scan.meta.json; abstained records are input context only

expected_outputs.description: one row per consumed candidate with its ladder rung, route and exact reason
generator, counts per route, and the carried-table dependency hashes the wave was computed against

evidence_policy.statement: Every disposition cites the bridge record's contract_id, its canonical quran loc, and the carried form row address it depends on. A carried-table lookup is source-addressed candidate evidence about a written surface; it is never, by itself, evidence of lexeme identity, sense, or function.
evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If the evidence ladder does not reach the rung a route needs, record source_gap with the precise missing evidence. Prefer pending over wrong.

guards: the METHOD of this consumption wave transfers to later waves; the linguistic conclusion about any single occurrence never transfers to another occurrence or surface
the crosswalk entry_id is the page that displays the word: it is page context and may never become a lexeme, form or sense edge
a root-family relation is never a lexeme identity, and a candidate graph edge is never a certified edge
a normalized-only surface match is a never_auto_resolve trigger and must stay blocked
collision records keep every preserved candidate: no route may select one and drop the others
the bridge projector is registered never_auto_resolve; certification remains solely with tools/certify_typed_fact.py on its own evidence bundle
defeaters: a disposition that treats a bridge candidate as certified evidence
a disposition that resolves a collision without new context evidence
a disposition derived from an abstained record
any output row whose canonical loc does not match the bridge record it cites

positive.expectation: a single-candidate record routes to a named sarf ladder rung with its form-source address cited
an abstained record appears only as context and produces no disposition row

adversarial.expectation: a lexical_collision_requires_context record must not produce a single-winner disposition; it routes to context review with all candidates intact
a page_context_only_no_lexical_edge record must never produce a lexeme edge for the displaying entry

acceptance_tests.name: bridge behaviour holds
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: ok is true and every mutation test passes

non_deployment.statement: This packet produces candidate dispositions and review routes only. No bridge record may be materialized publicly, shown to a learner, or written to the live site; certification stays with the owner-gated certifier on its own evidence bundle.

conditions: a collision needs occurrence context that no committed artifact supplies
a candidate would require an iʿrāb-bearing judgement to route
the carried-table dependency hashes changed mid-wave
escalation_trigger.route: two-vote queue for iʿrāb-bearing routes; source-gap packet for missing context; rerun the wave from a fresh release if the dependency hashes moved

definition_of_done: every candidate record in the bounded wave has exactly one disposition with an exact reason
no collision record was resolved by selection
no bridge record was certified, materialized publicly, or made learner-visible
the carried-table dependency hashes are recorded so the wave can be invalidated mechanically
